name: slack-hub
title: Slack Hub
description: Search Slack conversations, people, and messages, review messages addressed to you, and post or reply in threads; requires a modified slack-cli and your own Slack user token.
author: shinonomelon

preferences.name: slackCliPath
preferences.title: slack-cli Path
preferences.description: 改造版 slack-cli の dist/index.js、または slack-cli のコマンドのパス（~ 可）。空なら ~/.volta/bin・/opt/homebrew/bin・/usr/local/bin の順に slack-cli を探します

preferences.name: nodePath
preferences.title: Node Path
preferences.description: slack-cli Path が .js のときに使う node のパス（~ 可）。空なら同じ順に node を探します

preferences.name: slackCliProfile
preferences.title: slack-cli Profile
preferences.description: slack-cli config set --profile で付けた名前。空なら --profile を付けません

preferences.name: previousHandles
preferences.title: Previous Handles
preferences.description: Slack のハンドルを変えたことがある人だけ。前のハンドルをカンマ区切りで

commands.name: slack-hub
commands.title: Slack Hub
commands.description: Search Slack channels, people, and group DMs, open them in Slack, and write to them.

commands.name: refresh-directory
commands.title: Refresh Slack Directory
commands.description: Refresh the cached Slack channels, people, and joined channels every 5 minutes when they are stale.

commands.name: slack-drafts
commands.title: Slack Drafts
commands.description: Review the drafts you saved from Slack Hub, open them in Slack, and delete the records.
